planets.name: Kepler-5 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-5 with a 3.55-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: Kepler-5 b was found in 2009 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-5. Its orbit and size follow Esteves et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ESTEVES_ET_AL__2015): disc_year 2009, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.5484655, pl_radj 1.426, pl_bmassj 2.111

quotes.title: Kepler-5b
quotes.card: Kepler-5b is one of the first five planets discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft.
quotes.introduction: It is a hot Jupiter that orbits a subgiant star that is more massive, larger, and more diffuse than the Sun is.
